items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: as opposed to a more overtly amiable person like, say Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: Do you think that uh...looking again at the broader perspective, was this kind of part of the changing social firmament? Because you hear a lot about musicians say, as you mentioned, being more serious on the band stand as opposed to–and and I don’t want, I’m not saying this to be disparaging, but–uh as opposed to a more overtly amiable person like, say Louis Armstrong.
